description: 한국철도공사_금천구청 및 석수역의 지하철 승하차 데이터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 2022년 석수역과 금천구청역의 광역철도(지하철) 승하차 이용객 수를 기록한 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 역별 승하차 현황, 시간대별 이용 패턴, 역세권 유동인구, 출퇴근 혼잡도, 대중교통 이용률. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
